title: Golay Code / W(3,3) Triality
statement: The binary Golay code G_24 has parameters [gauge_mult, k, 2^q] = [24, 12, 8] and the ternary Golay code G_12 has parameters [k, q!, q!] = [12, 6, 6]. Both simultaneously encode the substrate primitives {gauge_mult, k, 2^q, q!}. Their automorphism groups act on exactly gauge_mult = 24 and k = 12 points respectively, the two primary substrate counting primitives.

triality.joint_encoding: Together: {gauge_mult, k, 2^q, q!} — all primary substrate primitives
triality.automorphism_actions: M_24 on gauge_mult, M_12 on k

law: The binary Golay G_24 parameters are (gauge_mult, k, 2^q); the ternary Golay G_12 parameters are (k, q!, q!); together they encode all four primary W(3,3) substrate counting primitives, with Aut groups acting on the two primary vertex counts.
